text: thats fine it works can u add a merge faces so i can turn some cuts into one clean face again
resolution: Added a 'merge' button to the Studio face-mode toolbar (shows when >=2 faces are selected): it calls the new pure editMesh.mergeFaces, which dissolves a coplanar, edge-connected face group back into one clean face — the inverse of a loop cut. It extracts the region's outer boundary from the selected faces' directed edges (shared/internal edges cancel), chains it into one loop, drops the leftover collinear seam verts, builds a single face with the shared normal + appearance, and compacts the freed interior verts. Rejects under-2, non-coplanar, or disconnected/holey selections (toasts why). Verified by 2 new editMesh.test.ts cases; full suite 92/92.
